meta.name: analyze
meta.description: Structured analysis for any input. Data, code, text, decisions, visuals. Prioritize, question, conclude.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对任何输入进行结构化分析，得出清晰结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要从杂乱信息中提取重点
copy.tagline_en: Analyze any input with structure, prioritize, question, and conclude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to extract key points from messy information

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按「目的→结构→分析→优先级→结论」的流程处理输入，标记信息来源，区分事实与观点，并主动寻找反证。
howto.when: 当你提供数据、代码、文本、决策或视觉材料需要分析，或要求结构化评估时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这份销售数据，指出优先级和反证。
say.note: Claude会运用框架分析并标记来源

say.text: 分析这段代码的潜在问题，区分语法错误和逻辑缺陷。
say.note: Claude会专注于生产破坏和死代码

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude processes input using the 'Purpose → Structure → Analyze → Prioritize → Conclude' workflow, labels sources, distinguishes facts from opinions, and actively seeks counter-evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide data, code, text, decisions, or visuals for analysis, or request a structured evaluation.

say_en.text: Analyze this sales data, highlight priorities and counter-evidence.
say_en.note: Claude uses a framework and marks sources

say_en.text: Analyze this code for potential issues, distinguishing syntax from logic bugs.
say_en.note: Claude focuses on production breaks and dead code
